markdown.markdown: ```python core.CCOutput( time, state_variables, state_variable_names, diagnostic_variables, solution, run_name, ) ``` Container for the results of one call to ``CCModel.integrate()``. ``CCOutput`` carries the full trajectory produced by the solver and exposes output-focused operations (noise addition, pyleoclim export, time resampling). Keeping these on the output rather than on the model means a single model instance can produce multiple independent outputs without them overwriting each other. ## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes} [**model_time**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation} : Raw time axis as returned by the solver. Never modified after construction; inspect this to understand the solver's actual grid. [**time**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation} : User-facing time axis. Starts equal to ``model_time``; replaced by ``reframe_time_axis`` when a different grid is requested. ``state_variables`` is always aligned to ``time``. [**state_variables**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [structured ndarray]{.parameter-annotation} : Named state variable arrays, indexed by variable name. [**state_variable_names**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [list of str]{.parameter-annotation} : Ordered list of state variable names. [**diagnostic_variables**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [dict of str → ndarray]{.parameter-annotation} : Named diagnostic arrays. [**solution**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[object](`object`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Raw solver output (retained for dense-output resampling via ``reframe_time_axis``). [**run_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Label for this integration run. ## Methods | Name | Description | | --- | --- | | [add_noise](#climatecritters.core.CCOutput.add_noise) | Add externally provided noise to an output variable. | | [get_series_by_name](#climatecritters.core.CCOutput.get_series_by_name) | Return a variable's array and its storage location. | | [reframe_time_axis](#climatecritters.core.CCOutput.reframe_time_axis) | Resample state variables onto a new time axis. | | [remove_noise](#climatecritters.core.CCOutput.remove_noise) | Restore a variable to its pre-noise values. | | [to_pyleo](#climatecritters.core.CCOutput.to_pyleo) | Export one or more variables as pyleoclim Series objects. | ### add_noise { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.add_noise } ```python core.CCOutput.add_noise(var_name, noise_ts) ``` Add externally provided noise to an output variable. The unmodified values are saved on the first call so that ``remove_noise`` can restore the clean series. #### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**var_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Name of a state or diagnostic variable. [**noise_ts**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Noise series with the same shape as the target variable. ### get_series_by_name { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.get_series_by_name } ```python core.CCOutput.get_series_by_name(var_name) ``` Return a variable's array and its storage location. State variables live in a structured numpy array; diagnostic variables live in a dict. Returning the location string lets callers that write back (e.g. ``add_noise``) know which container to update. #### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} [**values**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation} : [**location**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [{\'state\', \'diagnostic\'}]{.parameter-annotation} : ### reframe_time_axis { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.reframe_time_axis } ```python core.CCOutput.reframe_time_axis(t_eval) ``` Resample state variables onto a new time axis. Uses the dense output from ``solve_ivp`` when available (accurate polynomial interpolation); falls back to linear interpolation for fixed-step solvers. After this call, ``time`` is replaced by ``t_eval`` and ``state_variables`` is replaced by the interpolated values. ``model_time`` is never modified and always reflects the solver's original grid. #### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**t_eval**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation} : Target time axis. #### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} [**reframed**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [structured ndarray or ndarray]{.parameter-annotation} : Resampled state variables on ``t_eval``. ### remove_noise { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.remove_noise } ```python core.CCOutput.remove_noise(var_name) ``` Restore a variable to its pre-noise values. Reverses ``add_noise`` by replacing the noisy array with the clean copy saved on the first ``add_noise`` call. ### to_pyleo { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.to_pyleo } ```python core.CCOutput.to_pyleo(var_names=None) ``` Export one or more variables as pyleoclim Series objects. #### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} [**var_names**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [str or list of str]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default} : Name(s) of state or diagnostic variable(s) to export. #### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} []{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[pyleoclim](`pyleoclim`).[Series](`pyleoclim.Series`) or [pyleoclim](`pyleoclim`).[MultipleSeries](`pyleoclim.MultipleSeries`)]{.parameter-annotation} :
